final_recommendation: The room failed to converge on a unified path. Bondholder counsel committed to filing at 9 AM regardless of FINMA's written commitments, locking in carrier reserves and contagion pricing. FINMA offered a 30% recovery floor with June 18 determination and prospective equity-sequencing language, but the market analyst confirmed this would not prevent 200-250bp spread widening across the AT1 sector. The tail locked when consolidated E&O notices were filed the night before, removing negotiation flexibility.

marker_evidence.creditor_hierarchy_controversy: Equity preservation while AT1 wiped to zero was the foundational grievance driving every exchange. marker_evidence.claims_tail: Multi-year litigation tail with $40-60M immediate E&O reserves, climbing monthly, was developed across R3-R8. Fragmented reinsurance capacity, carrier notice protocol, and reinsurance accumulation across single loss event were structured as concrete constraints on consortium funding.
marker_evidence.financial_lines_relevance: D&O and E&O carrier exposure was a driving thread from R1 onward.
